name: Bridge token pair
description: Issue matching tokens on two chains and cross-link them as a pair. Useful for protocols that intend a token to be redeemable across chains via off-chain bridging.

params.DESCRIPTION: BRIDGEME on chain A - paired with chain B via LINK

actions.note: Issue the canonical supply on chain A (typically the chain with the most liquidity).

params.DESCRIPTION: BRIDGEME on chain B - paired with chain A via LINK

actions.note: Issue the mirror supply on chain B. The supplies are independent on-chain - the cross-link is metadata, not a balance bridge.
Fill the COIN1/COIN2 tickers and action indices after rows 1 + 2 confirm.
